iteration8_change: Add 90/300 m step features through an identity-initialized input stem. Replace frozen-teacher preservation with supervised short/no-cable references.
held_constant: U-Net/Transformer backbones, Iter5 checkpoint initialization, Iter6 field label/group split, Iter4 synthetic replay, positive MIL and training cadence.
field_metric_policy: positive-only, group-held-out; unmatched candidates are unverified, not false positives

adaptation.calibration_semantics: CalibrationData no-cable/reference responses: event and interval negatives only at d>=30m; near-end event/interval and all terminal positions ignored; not healthy cable samples
adaptation.calibration_event_loss: mean softplus of top-128 valid event logits per curve
adaptation.calibration_interval_loss: 0.25 * mean softplus over valid interval bins
adaptation.feature_channels: Iter3 eight channels plus paired step detrend/global-RMS and detrend/local-RMS at 90m and 300m
adaptation.selection: synthetic val/base + 0.5 * field-positive val/base + 0.5 * raw calibration val loss

supervision_coverage.policy: Predictions in undefined synthetic target windows are excluded; measured-field inference remains full-grid.
